relationships.subject: vincristine
relationships.evidence_quote: Vincristine (VCR) is a well-known chemotherapeutic agent that frequently triggers neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: Ajugarin-I
relationships.evidence_quote: The behavioral results demonstrated that Aju-I (5 mg/kg) markedly alleviated VCR-induced neuropathic pain behaviors including hyperalgesia and allodynia.

key_findings: Ajugarin-I (5 mg/kg i.p.) alleviates vincristine-induced hyperalgesia and allodynia in mice and reverses histological damage in sciatic nerve, spinal cord and brain.
Ajugarin-I reduces oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis via Nrf2/NF-kB and Bcl-2/Bax signaling and crosses the blood-brain barrier.
